prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles—what’s best depends on your goals, budget, channels, industry, and how much you want the agency to own versus augment your team. I can help you find the right fit, but first:

Quick questions to narrow it down
- What are your top goals? (e.g., paid media performance, creative optimization, personalization, email/CRM, brand campaigns, conversational AI)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget and expected monthly agency retainer range?
- Industry (B2B, e‑commerce, consumer tech, entertainment, healthcare, etc.)?
- Channels you care about (social, search, programmatic, email, site personalization, in‑app)?
- Do you want a full-service agency or a specialist/technology vendor?

Agencies and vendors in/near LA that commonly use AI or ML in marketing (examples to consider)
- R/GA — global creative/technology agency known for building data-driven products, personalization and AI-enabled creative tech.
- VaynerMedia — strong in social, performance, and rapid adoption of new tools/AI-driven optimization for creative and media.
- Media.Monks — production + tech-heavy agency that builds custom AI/data solutions for campaigns and content at scale.
- 72andSunny — creative-first agency that integrates data and tech for audience targeting and optimized creative.
- Cortex (startup in LA) — AI platform focused on creative optimization and social content performance (good for brands wanting AI-driven creative guidance).
- Shutterstock (Pattern89 integration) — offers AI tools for ad creative and predictive insights after acquiring Pattern89; useful for creative testing and optimization.
- Specialist AI vendors you can pair with agencies: Persado or Phrasee (AI for language and messaging), Albert.ai (autonomous media buying/optimization).

How I can help next
- If you give your goals/budget/industry, I’ll shortlist 3–5 LA agencies/tech vendors that match and include likely costs, strengths, and questions to ask them.
- Or I can provide an RFP checklist and evaluation criteria (KPIs, tech stack, data access, case studies, SLAs) so you can vet agencies yourself.

Which direction do you want to take?
